answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a river bet on surviving 89 epochs of grading, and every comet settlement recomputes the jade schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 89 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 27 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
